archimate:Folder.name: retained applications
archimate:Folder.documentation:
Thos applications that will npt be retired (likely) and are therefore part of the target architecture. Listed by product subfolder.
This section must contain a brief description of what each app does & any other useful details not captured in other docs.
All apps should be in our: 1. application catalogue 2. integration catalogue 3. tech debt register
where known we should include their end of service date
if we know the likely successor we should include that and ensure that the successor is present in this model we should also include a LeanIX link (or note that application doesn't exist in LeanIX)
